method.sampling: same pinned code/prose prompts and sampling; greedy functional/recall checks
method.decode_metric: SSE completion tokens divided by time after first token; native timings separately retained
method.selection: fastest fully eligible 32 GB tier within 5% of best native prefill and each code/prose decode, with TTFT <= max(1.25x fastest, fastest+0.05s)
method.guards: loading-swap-v3; unlimited phase-aware swap; 3 GiB sustained physical RAM/VRAM floors; 1.5 GiB hard VRAM floor; 5/6 GiB startup free; zero dedicated-VRAM spill; owned scopes; unchanged source/binary/pack/precision/context/concurrency checks
method.limits: Sequential small sample; cache, execution order, desktop activity, thermal/power and storage effects remain. Synthetic checks establish sampled functional/recall behavior, not general quality equivalence. Historical 64 GB results are informational, not a matched causal RAM comparison.
